DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT (DPA)

This Data Processing Agreement supplements the services agreement between the
Data Controller and the Data Processor and governs the processing of personal
data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

The Processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures
to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including measures to
protect against phishing, social engineering, and unauthorised disclosure of
personal data. Staff receive regular anti-phishing awareness training.

Sub-processors are listed in Annex III. Data subject rights requests will be
supported by the Processor.

This Agreement remains valid until June 30, 2028 unless terminated earlier.
